# Project card

> A product in the work grid: 4:5 video (4:3 on phones) with a number and the product's own logo on a paper chip, then title and mono kind, a one-line description, and a full-width visit bar.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/project-card/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- Real products only, with real recorded video and the product's own logo. Product logos and videos are not part of the design system: get them from the product (the docs examples use copies from the website).
- Three per row on desktop, two below 1100px, one below 760px. With fewer items the grid keeps three columns and leaves the space empty, as the site's CSS does.
- No video yet: keep the .media frame (it has the --card background) with the logo chip and a visible mono [PLACEHOLDER: product video] inside it. Do not use a still from another product or a mock-up.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Two cards in the work grid

```html
  <div class="grid3">
      <article class="card">
        <a class="media" href="https://paryatech.in" target="_blank" rel="noopener" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">
          <video muted loop playsinline preload="metadata" poster="/examples/media/paryatech.jpg" src="/examples/media/paryatech.mp4"></video>
          <span class="veil"></span><span class="num t-mono" aria-hidden="true">01</span>
          <span class="plogo"><img src="/examples/media/paryatech-wordmark.svg" alt="Paryatech" loading="lazy"></span>
        </a>
        <div class="meta"><h3>Paryatech</h3><span class="t-mono kind">Travel SaaS</span></div>
        <p>Brings a travel agency’s enquiries, itineraries, bookings and finances together in one place.</p>
        <a class="bar t-mono" href="https://paryatech.in" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="bt">Visit paryatech.in</span><span class="sr"> (opens in a new tab)</span><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span></a>
      </article>
      <article class="card">
        <a class="media" href="https://sachit.vimaksh.in/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">
          <video muted loop playsinline preload="metadata" poster="/examples/media/sachit.jpg" src="/examples/media/sachit.mp4"></video>
          <span class="veil"></span><span class="num t-mono" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
          <span class="plogo plogo--icon"><img src="/examples/media/sachit.svg" alt="" loading="lazy"><b>Sachit</b></span>
        </a>
        <div class="meta"><h3>Sachit</h3><span class="t-mono kind">Support desk</span></div>
        <p>Turns emails and in-app requests into support tickets your team can organise, track and resolve.</p>
        <a class="bar t-mono" href="https://sachit.vimaksh.in/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="bt">Visit sachit.vimaksh.in</span><span class="sr"> (opens in a new tab)</span><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span></a>
      </article></div>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `article.card` | element | Flex column; the bar is pushed to the bottom so cards in a row align. |
| `a.media` | element | Video link, tabindex -1 and aria-hidden: the visit bar is the one real link. |
| `video` | element | muted loop playsinline preload="metadata" with a poster; plays only while on screen. |
| `.veil` | element | Light top-to-bottom darkening plus grain at .35 overlay. |
| `.num.t-mono` | element | Large white number, bottom left. Optional: numbering is an open voice question (see Voice), so leave it out of new work until Vimaksh decides. |
| `.plogo` | element | The product logo on a paper chip (see Logo chip). |
| `.meta > h3 + .kind` | element | Title and a lowercase mono kind ("travel saas"). |
| `a.bar.t-mono` | element | "Visit host >", opens in a new tab with a visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)". |

## Do

- Write the description as one plain sentence about what the product does.
- Keep video saturation at .82 until hover.

## Don't

- Do not recolour product logos or tint videos.
- Do not round the media or add shadows.
- Do not invent products, metrics or clients to fill the grid.

## Accessibility

- One link per card (the bar); the media link is hidden from assistive tech to avoid duplicates.
- The logo image carries the product name as alt.
- Videos are muted and decorative; they pause off screen.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color.theme.card | `--card` | `#FBFAF7 / #17192E` |
| typography.card-title | `` | `{"fontFamily":"'Inter Tight',ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif","fontWeight":500,"fontSize":"clamp(18px,1.4vw,22px)","letterSpacing":"-.02em"}` |
| typography.card-copy | `` | `{"fontFamily":"'Inter Tight',ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif","fontSize":"15px","lineHeight":"1.42"}` |
| space.grid-gap | `--grid-gap` | `14px` |
| space.grid-row-gap | `--grid-row-gap` | `clamp(40px,4vw,64px)` |
| motion.duration.media | `--dur-media` | `1400ms` |

# Logo chip

> A product's own logo on an off-white chip in the top-left corner of a project card. Three forms: a full logo, an icon with the name, or the name alone.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/logo-chip/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- Only on project media.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` (no JavaScript).

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Logo, icon + name, text

```html
<div style="display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap"><div class="card" style="width:240px"><span class="media" style="aspect-ratio:3/1;background:var(--night)"><span class="plogo"><img src="/examples/media/paryatech-wordmark.svg" alt="Paryatech"></span></span></div><div class="card" style="width:240px"><span class="media" style="aspect-ratio:3/1;background:var(--night)"><span class="plogo plogo--icon"><img src="/examples/media/vaat.svg" alt=""><b>Vaat</b></span></span></div><div class="card" style="width:240px"><span class="media" style="aspect-ratio:3/1;background:var(--night)"><span class="plogo plogo--text"><b>Godspeed</b></span></span></div></div>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.plogo` | class | 48px high (40px phones), rgba(251,250,247,.95) fill, 1px bottom shadow. |
| `.plogo--icon` | modifier | Square icon (22px) followed by the name in 16px semibold. |
| `.plogo--text` | modifier | Name only, for products without a logo file. |

## Do

- Use the product's own logo file unchanged, even when it breaks a Vimaksh rule (Vaat's icon has rounded corners and its own indigo: keep them).

## Don't

- Do not recolour a product logo to Vimaksh colours.

## Accessibility

- Full logos: alt = product name. Icon + name: empty alt, the name is text.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| shadow.chip | `--shadow-chip` | `0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08)` |
| font.weight.semibold | `--w-semibold` | `600` |

## Sources

- markup: [tools/v5pages.py:154-159](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/tools/v5pages.py#L154-L159)
- style: [src/v5/v5.css:591-595](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/v5.css#L591-L595)

# Build card and track

> The "What we build" row: cards with a pixel tile in the item's own colour, a numbered tag, a square bullet and a short description, on a track that drifts sideways on its own and pauses on hover, touch or focus.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/build-track/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- For a set of parallel categories, each with its own colour.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### What we build (it drifts; hover to slow, use the arrows)

```html
<section class="build" id="services" aria-labelledby="build-h">
  <div class="build-head">
    <p class="t-mono label"><span class="chev">&gt;</span> What we build</p>
    <div class="build-copy">
      <h2 id="build-h" class="t-big">Custom software, and nothing else. From a Chrome extension to an industry-specific SaaS, AI automation, CRM or ERP: if your business runs on it, we build it.</h2>
    </div>
  </div>
  <ul class="track" data-track aria-label="Types of software we build">
      <li class="bcard" style="--c:#2D36FF">
        <div class="btile"><canvas class="px" data-px="saas" data-kind="extension" data-c="#2D36FF" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="t-mono bn">01</span></div>
        <h3>Chrome extensions</h3>
        <p>Tools that live in the browser, right where your team already works.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="bcard" style="--c:#E42114">
        <div class="btile"><canvas class="px" data-px="saas" data-kind="saas" data-c="#E42114" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="t-mono bn">02</span></div>
        <h3>Industry SaaS</h3>
        <p>Platforms shaped around one industry’s real workflows, not a generic template.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="bcard" style="--c:#7A3CD6">
        <div class="btile"><canvas class="px" data-px="saas" data-kind="ai" data-c="#7A3CD6" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="t-mono bn">03</span></div>
        <h3>AI automation</h3>
        <p>Agents and pipelines that read, sort, draft and decide, so people don’t have to.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="bcard" style="--c:#0E8F6E">
        <div class="btile"><canvas class="px" data-px="saas" data-kind="crm" data-c="#0E8F6E" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="t-mono bn">04</span></div>
        <h3>CRM</h3>
        <p>Leads, conversations and follow-ups in one place, built around how you sell.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="bcard" style="--c:#E8730C">
        <div class="btile"><canvas class="px" data-px="saas" data-kind="erp" data-c="#E8730C" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="t-mono bn">05</span></div>
        <h3>ERP</h3>
        <p>Inventory, orders, finance and people, connected end to end.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="bcard" style="--c:#0A8FB0">
        <div class="btile"><canvas class="px" data-px="saas" data-kind="dashboard" data-c="#0A8FB0" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="t-mono bn">06</span></div>
        <h3>Internal tools</h3>
        <p>Admin panels and dashboards that turn scattered data into clear decisions.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="bcard" style="--c:#C99400">
        <div class="btile"><canvas class="px" data-px="saas" data-kind="integrations" data-c="#C99400" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="t-mono bn">07</span></div>
        <h3>Integrations & APIs</h3>
        <p>The glue between your systems: syncs, webhooks and APIs that just work.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="bcard" style="--c:#D23C7E">
        <div class="btile"><canvas class="px" data-px="saas" data-kind="mobile" data-c="#D23C7E" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="t-mono bn">08</span></div>
        <h3>Mobile & field apps</h3>
        <p>Apps for the people on the move, online or off.</p>
      </li>
  </ul>
  <div class="track-foot">
    <span class="track-bar" aria-hidden="true"><i data-track-bar></i></span>
    <div class="track-btns"><button type="button" class="tbtn" data-track-prev aria-label="Previous"><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true">&lt;</span></button><button type="button" class="tbtn" data-track-next aria-label="Next"><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span></button></div>
  </div>
</section>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ul.track[data-track]` | element | Horizontal scroller. vimaksh.js clones the cards once so the drift loops. |
| `li.bcard[style="--c:…"]` | element | One kind of software; --c is its colour (color.kind.*). |
| `canvas.px[data-px=saas][data-kind][data-c]` | element | The pixel tile, drawn by pixel/pixelsaas.js and redrawn on theme change. |
| `.bn.t-mono` | element | The number on the colour. |
| `.track-foot` | element | Scrubber ([data-track-bar]) and arrow buttons ([data-track-prev], [data-track-next]). |

## Do

- Use only the eight kind colours, one per card.

## Don't

- Do not use kind colours anywhere else in the interface.
- Do not let it drift with reduced motion faster than 18px/s (vimaksh.js handles this).

## Accessibility

- Clones are aria-hidden.
- Drift stops while a card inside has keyboard focus.
- Arrow buttons have aria-labels.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color.kind.extension | `--kind-extension` | `#2D36FF` |
| border.stripe | `--stripe` | `3px` |
| typography.build-title | `` | `{"fontFamily":"'Inter Tight',ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif","fontWeight":500,"fontSize":"clamp(19px,1.5vw,24px)","letterSpacing":"-.02em"}` |
| space.grid-gap | `--grid-gap` | `14px` |

- section: [tools/v5pages.py:228-242](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/tools/v5pages.py#L228-L242)

# About block

> A short statement section: a compact pixel illustration on the left and one large paragraph (t-big) on the right, centred on one line.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/about-block/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- Once per page, for who we are.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### About on the home page

```html
<section class="about-home" id="about" aria-labelledby="about-h">
  <div class="ab-text">
    <p class="t-mono label"><span class="chev">&gt;</span> About us</p>
    <h2 id="about-h" class="t-big">Vimaksh builds digital products with a distinct perspective and a practical approach. The company brings clarity to product decisions, care to design and depth to engineering, shaping each experience around the people who use it.</h2>
  </div>
  <figure class="ab-art"><canvas class="px" data-px="desk" role="img" aria-label="Pixel illustration: a studio desk with a laptop showing the mark's arrows, a red mug and a plant"></canvas></figure>
</section>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `section.about-home` | element | Grid clamp(220px,24vw,340px) + 1fr; one column below 760px. |
| `.ab-art canvas.px[data-px=desk]` | element | The pixel desk, with role="img" and a written description. |
| `h2.t-big` | element | The statement. |

## Do

- Describe the illustration in aria-label.

## Don't

- Do not replace the illustration with a stock photo.

## Accessibility

- The canvas has role="img" and an aria-label describing the picture.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| typography.big | `.t-big` | `{"fontFamily":"'Inter Tight',ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif","fontWeight":450,"fontSize":"clamp(26px,2.9vw,48px)","lineHeight":"1.08","letterSpacing":"-.03em","color":"var(--strong)"}` |
| space.section-compact | `--section-compact` | `clamp(56px,6vw,96px)` |

# Hero

> The home opening: a living pixel surface (WebGL) where a field of tiny ">" and "<" glyphs flows across paper and the Vimaksh mark assembles from the same pixels. Copy sits top left, a mono meta line bottom left. The page rises over it as you scroll.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/hero/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- Home page only (a site's landing page; a one-page product site counts as one). It is the one always-moving visual.
- The .hl highlight (red, wrapped in "<" ">") marks at most one phrase in the hero headline.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh.js + pixel-hero.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Pixel hero (WebGL; falls back to the static mark)

```html
<section class="hero" id="top" aria-label="Vimaksh — Boil the Ocean.">
  <div class="hero-in">
    <canvas id="stage" aria-label="The Vimaksh six-arrow mark, built from moving pixels" role="img"></canvas>
    <img class="stage-fallback" src="/dist/brand/svg/vimaksh-mark.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="hero-grain" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="hero-copy">
      <p class="t-mono label"><span class="chev">&gt;</span> Boil the Ocean.</p>
      <h1>We turn <span class="hl"><i aria-hidden="true">&lt;</i>what if?<i aria-hidden="true">&gt;</i></span> into products, platforms and experiments you can actually use.</h1>
      <div class="hero-cta"><a class="btn" href="#work"><span>Explore our work</span><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span></a><a class="btn btn--ghost" href="/contact/"><span>Start a project</span></a></div>
    </div>
    <p class="hero-meta t-mono"><span>Studio / Bengaluru</span><span>12.92° N 77.60° E</span><span data-clock>--:--:--</span></p>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-dim" aria-hidden="true"></div>
</section>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `section.hero` | element | Sticky, one viewport high (min 620px, 560px phones). |
| `canvas#stage` | element | The pixel surface; vimaksh.js loads pixel-hero.js only when it exists. |
| `img.stage-fallback` | element | The mark, shown when WebGL is unavailable (.no-gl). |
| `.hero-copy` | element | Label, H1 (with an optional .hl "<what if?>" highlight) and up to two buttons. The field thins out under it. |
| `.hero-meta.t-mono` | element | Small facts, bottom left; hidden on phones. |
| `.hero-dim / --p` | state (JS) | The hero dims and scales to .95 as the next section rises. |

## Do

- Keep the headline short enough to stay inside the copy box.
- Follow it with a section that has a paper pixel edge on top (.rise).

## Don't

- Do not add a second animated scene anywhere else.
- Do not place text over the mark.

## Accessibility

- The canvas has role="img" and a description; all copy is real DOM.
- With reduced motion the field runs at half speed; it pauses off screen and in hidden tabs.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color.pixel.hero-mist-light | `--px-hero-mist-l` | `#DDE4FF` |
| color.pixel.hero-glyph-light | `--px-hero-glyph-l` | `#2D36FF` |
| color.brand.coral | `--coral` | `#FF5E55` |
| color.brand.red | `--red` | `#E42114` |
| typography.hero-lead | `` | `{"fontFamily":"'Inter Tight',ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif","fontWeight":500,"fontSize":"clamp(28px,2.7vw,48px)","lineHeight":"1.04","letterSpacing":"-.035em"}` |

## Sources

- markup: [tools/v5pages.py:193-206](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/tools/v5pages.py#L193-L206)

# Contact block

> Bordered card blocks made of rows: a red "Start a project" row that drops open the brief form, plain rows with copy pills, and a split block for the studio address and coordinates.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/contact-block/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- On the contact page; the footer uses the same brief as a light card (.fbrief).

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh.js + vimaksh-phone.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Contact page (click "Start a project")

```html
<section class="contact-page" aria-labelledby="ct-h">
  <div class="ct-left">
    <p class="t-mono label"><span class="chev">&gt;</span> Contact</p>
    <h1 id="ct-h" class="t-hero">The best work begins with the right introduction.</h1>
  </div>
  <div class="ct-right">
    <div class="block">
      <div class="brief">
        <button class="row row--brief" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="brief-panel" data-brief>
          <span>Start a project</span><span class="pill t-mono">Submit brief <span class="tri" aria-hidden="true">▸</span></span>
        </button>
        <div class="brief-panel" id="brief-panel"><div>
          <form class="brief-form" data-brief-form novalidate>
            <label class="hp" aria-hidden="true">Website<input name="website" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></label>
            <div class="f2"><label><span class="t-mono">Name</span><input name="name" required autocomplete="name"></label>
            <label><span class="t-mono">Email</span><input name="email" type="email" required autocomplete="email" maxlength="254" data-check="email"><span class="ferr" aria-live="polite"></span></label></div>
            <div class="f2"><label><span class="t-mono">Phone</span><input name="phone" type="tel" required autocomplete="tel" data-check="phone"><span class="ferr" aria-live="polite"></span></label>
            <label><span class="t-mono">Company <i>(optional)</i></span><input name="company" autocomplete="organization"></label></div>
            <label><span class="t-mono">Tell us about it</span><textarea name="message" rows="4" required></textarea></label>
            <div class="f-foot"><button class="btn" type="submit"><span>Send brief</span><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span></button><p class="t-mono note" data-brief-note aria-live="polite"></p></div>
          </form>
        </div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="row"><span>General enquiries</span><button class="pill t-mono" type="button" data-copy="hq@vimaksh.in">hq@vimaksh.in</button></div>
      <div class="row"><span>New projects</span><button class="pill t-mono" type="button" data-copy="hq@vimaksh.in">hq@vimaksh.in</button></div>
    </div>
    <div class="block block--split">
      <div class="cell"><span>Studio</span><address class="addr"><a href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/ktwso9ycC2Ufo8Tt7" target="_blank" rel="noopener">3rd Floor, Eshaaya 1629<br>E End Main Rd, 4th T Block East<br>Jayanagar 9th Block, Tilak Nagar<br>Bengaluru, Karnataka 560041</a></address></div>
      <div class="cell"><span class="t-mono soft">Coordinates</span><button class="pill t-mono" type="button" data-copy="12.9210° N, 77.5960° E">12.92° N 77.60° E</button><span class="t-mono soft">Bengaluru now · <span data-clock>--:--:--</span> IST</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.block` | class | --rule2 border on --card. |
| `.row` | class | 20px 22px, 17px text, hairline between rows. A <button> or <div>. |
| `button.row.row--brief[data-brief][aria-expanded]` | element | The red row; toggles .brief.open and focuses the first field. |
| `.brief-panel` | element | Opens by animating grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr over .6s. |
| `.block--split > .cell` | element | Two cells (1.6fr / 1fr), stacked on phones. |

## Do

- Keep the brief one click away and show the email beside it.

## Don't

- Do not hide the email behind the form.

## Accessibility

- The red row is a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color.brand.red | `--red` | `#E42114` |
| color.brand.red-d | `--red-d` | `#B5180E` |
| color.theme.card | `--card` | `#FBFAF7 / #17192E` |
| color.theme.rule2 | `--rule2` | `rgba(44,20,18,.3) / rgba(221,228,255,.3)` |

# Brief form

> The project brief: name, email, phone, company (optional) and a message. Fields are underlines with mono labels; email and phone are checked as you type and explained when you leave the field. It posts JSON to the form's action (the site uses /api/brief) and shows an honest result.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/brief-form/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- For starting a conversation. Ask only what you need.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh.js + vimaksh-phone.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Footer brief card (light card on the dark footer)

```html
<div class="foot" style="padding:40px var(--pad)"><div style="max-width:620px">      <div class="block fbrief" id="brief">
        <div class="row row--brief"><span>Start a project</span><button class="pill t-mono" type="button" data-copy="hq@vimaksh.in">hq@vimaksh.in</button></div>
          <form class="brief-form" data-brief-form novalidate>
            <label class="hp" aria-hidden="true">Website<input name="website" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></label>
            <div class="f2"><label><span class="t-mono">Name</span><input name="name" required autocomplete="name"></label>
            <label><span class="t-mono">Email</span><input name="email" type="email" required autocomplete="email" maxlength="254" data-check="email"><span class="ferr" aria-live="polite"></span></label></div>
            <div class="f2"><label><span class="t-mono">Phone</span><input name="phone" type="tel" required autocomplete="tel" data-check="phone"><span class="ferr" aria-live="polite"></span></label>
            <label><span class="t-mono">Company <i>(optional)</i></span><input name="company" autocomplete="organization"></label></div>
            <label><span class="t-mono">Tell us about it</span><textarea name="message" rows="3" required></textarea></label>
            <div class="f-foot"><button class="btn" type="submit"><span>Send brief</span><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span></button><p class="t-mono note" data-brief-note aria-live="polite"></p></div>
          </form>
      </div></div></div><div class="tip t-mono" aria-hidden="true">Copy</div>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form.brief-form[data-brief-form][novalidate]` | element | vimaksh.js validates and submits; posts to action (default /api/brief). |
| `label.hp` | element | Honeypot field, off screen and aria-hidden. |
| `.f2` | class | Two fields side by side; one column below 760px. |
| `label > span.t-mono + input` | element | Label above, underline input (16px, 12px 0 padding). |
| `i (inside the label)` | element | "(optional)" at 70% opacity. |
| `[data-check=email|phone]` | attribute | Live checks; the message goes in the label's .ferr. |
| `.f-foot > .btn + p.note[data-brief-note]` | element | Submit and the result line (.is-ok green, .is-err red). |
| `form[action]` | attribute | Where the JSON is posted. Default /api/brief. The endpoint must answer {"ok":true} or {"ok":false,"error":"…"}. |
| `form[data-sent]` | attribute | Success message; {name} and {email} are filled in. Default: "Thanks, {name}. Your brief is with us, and a confirmation is on its way to {email}." |
| `form[data-email]` | attribute | The email offered in the error message. Default hq@vimaksh.in. |
| `.fbrief` | class | The light brief card on the dark footer (resets the light theme tokens locally). |

## Do

- Label every field; mark only the optional ones.
- Say what happened only after the real response.

## Don't

- Do not use placeholders as labels.
- Do not show success before the server confirms.

## Accessibility

- Errors are in aria-live regions inside the label.
- The first invalid field receives focus on submit.
- autocomplete is set on name, email, tel and organization.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| typography.mono | `.t-mono` | `{"fontFamily":"'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace","fontWeight":500,"fontSize":"11px","lineHeight":"1.45","letterSpacing":".06em","textTransform":"uppercase"}` |
| typography.field-error | `` | `{"fontFamily":"'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace","fontWeight":500,"fontSize":"10.5px","lineHeight":"1.4","letterSpacing":".03em"}` |
| space.field-gap | `--field-gap` | `16px` |
| color.brand.red | `--red` | `#E42114` |
| color.status.live | `--ok` | `#16a34a` |
| shadow.card | `--shadow-card` | `0 30px 70px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.6)` |

- markup: [tools/v5pages.py:71-80](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/tools/v5pages.py#L71-L80)
- fields: [src/v5/v5.css:242-251](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/v5.css#L242-L251)

# Inputs and validation

> Text fields are a single underline: --rule2 at rest, red on focus and when invalid. Errors are short mono lines under the field. The send button shows "Sending…", then "Sent" in green, or the error note in red with the email as a fallback.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/inputs/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- Check quietly while typing; show the message when the field is left or on send.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Invalid email, sending, and the error note

```html
<form class="brief-form" data-brief-form novalidate style="max-width:560px">
  <div class="f2"><label><span class="t-mono">Name</span><input name="name" required autocomplete="name" value="Asha Rao"></label>
  <label><span class="t-mono">Email</span><input name="email" type="email" class="bad" value="asha@gmial.com" data-check="email"><span class="ferr" aria-live="polite">Did you mean asha@gmail.com?</span></label></div>
  <label><span class="t-mono">Tell us about it</span><textarea name="message" rows="3" required></textarea></label>
  <div class="f-foot"><button class="btn" type="submit" disabled><span>Sending…</span><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span></button><p class="t-mono note is-err" aria-live="polite">Something went wrong. Please try again, or write to <a href="mailto:hq@vimaksh.in">hq@vimaksh.in</a>.</p></div>
</form>
```

### Error messages (exact copy, from the site)

```
Please enter your email.
Please enter a valid email, like name@company.com.
Did you mean <local>@gmail.com?        (gmial.com, gmai.com, gmail.co, gamil.com, yahooo.com, hotmial.com, outlok.com)
Please enter your phone number.
That country code doesn’t look right.
This number is too short for the country you chose.
This number is too long for the country you chose.
This number has the wrong number of digits for the country you chose.
Please enter a valid phone number for the country you chose.
Thanks, <first name>. Your brief is with us, and a confirmation is on its way to <email>.
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `input, textarea` | element | border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2); transparent; 16px. |
| `:focus` | state | Underline turns red. |
| `input.bad` | state | Underline red (set by vimaksh.js once you leave the field). |
| `.ferr` | element | 10.5px mono, red; hidden when empty. |
| `p.note.is-ok / .is-err` | state | Result line, green #15803d or red. |

## Do

- Write errors as one sentence that says how to fix it.

## Don't

- Do not put boxes around fields on light surfaces.
- Do not show an error while someone is still typing their first attempt.

## Accessibility

- setCustomValidity keeps native validity in step with the visible message.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color.theme.rule2 | `--rule2` | `rgba(44,20,18,.3) / rgba(221,228,255,.3)` |
| color.brand.red | `--red` | `#E42114` |
| typography.field-error | `` | `{"fontFamily":"'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace","fontWeight":500,"fontSize":"10.5px","lineHeight":"1.4","letterSpacing":".03em"}` |
| color.status.live-text | `--ok-text` | `#15803d` |

# Phone field

> intl-tel-input 29.5.11, themed to the site: a flag and +code in mono with a small red chevron, a square searchable country list on --card, India preselected and a short list of common countries first. Only valid digits can be typed.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/phone-field/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- Wherever a phone number is asked for.
- The grey example number inside the field comes from intl-tel-input (as on the site); it is a format hint, not a label: keep the mono label above.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh-phone.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Phone field (open the country list)

```html
<form class="brief-form" data-brief-form novalidate style="max-width:420px;padding:0;border:0"><label><span class="t-mono">Phone</span><input name="phone" type="tel" required autocomplete="tel" data-check="phone"><span class="ferr" aria-live="polite"></span></label></form>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `input[type=tel][data-check=phone]` | element | vimaksh-phone.js attaches intl-tel-input to it. |
| `countryOrder` | option | in, ae, us, gb, sg, au, ca, sa. |
| `strictMode, formatAsYouType, countrySearch, separateDialCode` | option | All on. |
| `vendor/intl-tel-input.css` | file | Load before vimaksh.css; vimaksh.css themes it. |

## Do

- Validate on the server too (the site uses libphonenumber-js in its worker).

## Don't

- Do not use a plain <select> for the country.

## Accessibility

- The country button is keyboard reachable with a visible focus ring; the list is searchable.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color.theme.card | `--card` | `#FBFAF7 / #17192E` |
| shadow.popover | `--shadow-popover` | `0 18px 40px -18px rgba(11,10,20,.35)` |
| color.brand.red | `--red` | `#E42114` |
| typography.mono | `.t-mono` | `{"fontFamily":"'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace","fontWeight":500,"fontSize":"11px","lineHeight":"1.45","letterSpacing":".06em","textTransform":"uppercase"}` |

## Sources

- set-up: [src/v5/main.js:63-83](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/main.js#L63-L83)
- theme: [src/v5/v5.css:769-807](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/v5.css#L769-L807)

# Footer

> Always dark (night) in both themes. A pixel edge breaks its top, the mark flies in, a large statement sits beside the brief card, four columns of facts follow, and a heat-gradient base carries the giant white wordmark.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/footer/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- On every page.
- Columns hold real links and facts only: navigation, products, contact. The website's street address, live clock and two-working-days promise are open voice questions (see Voice): do not copy them into new work.
- The right-hand slot holds either the light brief card (.fbrief) or the large email button.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `footer.foot` | element | var(--pattern-dark) on night; text #ECEEFF. |
| `canvas.edge.edge--top[data-edge=night]` | element | Pixel edge in night colour above the footer. |
| `.fmark` | element | The mark; its six arrows fly in when 60% visible (and on hover), the red one last. |
| `.foot-say` | element | Label, t-statement headline, supporting line. |
| `.cols` | element | Four columns (two below 1100px): mono keys, 16px links with a coral "> " on hover. |
| `.foot-base.heat[data-pixel-mask]` | element | Heat gradient whose top edge is cut into squares by a mask; giant wordmark; fine print. |

## Do

- Keep it dark in both themes.
- Keep facts factual: real links, real email.

## Don't

- Do not use the heat gradient anywhere else.
- Do not add social icons that do not exist.

## Accessibility

- The mark has role="img" and a label; the giant wordmark is aria-hidden (the name is elsewhere in text).
- Columns are real lists.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color.brand.night | `--night` | `#0D0E1C` |
| pattern.heat | `--heat` | `radial-gradient(120% 90% at 0% 100%,#1A3FD8 0%,rgba(45,54,255,.55) 28%,transparent 55%),radial-gradient(80% 70% at 85% 80%,#5A0C12 0%,rgba(140,20,20,.6) 35%,transparent 70%),radial-gradient(90% 80% at 60% 20%,#FF7A70 0%,rgba(255,94,85,.6) 30%,transparent 65%),linear-gradient(160deg,#E42114 0%,#FF5E55 40%,#9C2B5A 70%,#2D36FF 100%)` |
| pattern.paper-dark | `--pattern-dark` | `var(--cross-l) 0 0/192px 192px,radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px,rgba(221,228,255,.06) .9px,transparent 1.3px) 0 0/24px 24px` |
| color.footer.text | `--foot-text` | `#ECEEFF` |
| color.footer.label | `--foot-label` | `#9aa0c8` |
| color.footer.key | `--foot-key` | `#7b81aa` |
| typography.statement | `.t-statement` | `{"fontFamily":"'Inter Tight',ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif","fontWeight":500,"fontSize":"clamp(44px,7vw,112px)","lineHeight":".92","letterSpacing":"-.045em"}` |

# Pixel edge

> A band of squares, 7 rows of 14px cells (10px on phones), that thins toward the far edge. It joins one area to the next instead of a straight line: the hero to the work section, the page to the footer.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/pixel-edge/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- Only where a section rises over a different surface.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` and `vimaksh.js`.

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Paper edge rising over a dark area, and the night edge above the footer

```html
<div style="background:var(--night);height:140px"></div><section class="rise" style="padding:40px var(--pad) 60px"><canvas class="edge edge--top" data-edge="paper" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><p class="t-mono label"><span class="chev">&gt;</span> A section</p><p class="t-big">The paper edge sits on top of a section that rises over the area above.</p></section><footer class="foot" style="height:160px"><canvas class="edge edge--top" data-edge="night" aria-hidden="true"></canvas></footer>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `canvas.edge.edge--top[data-edge=paper|night]` | element | Absolutely positioned above its section; redrawn on resize and theme change. |
| `[data-pixel-mask]` | attribute | Cuts the top of an element (the heat base) into squares with a CSS mask. |
| `pixel/pixelart.js pixelEdge(canvas, {color, cell, seed, rows})` | function | Draw one yourself. |

## Do

- Use the colour of the section it belongs to.

## Don't

- Do not stack edges or use them as decoration inside a section.

## Accessibility

- Decorative: aria-hidden.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| pattern.pixel-edge | `` | `{"cell":"14px","cellPhone":"10px","rows":7,"seed":3}` |
| space.edge-h | `--edge-h` | `98px` |

## Sources

- style: [src/v5/v5.css:360-361](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/v5.css#L360-L361)
- drawing: [src/v5/pixelart.js:16-25](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/pixelart.js#L16-L25)
- mask: [src/v5/pixelsaas.js:20-31](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/pixelsaas.js#L20-L31)
- set-up: [src/v5/main.js:142-162](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/main.js#L142-L162)

# Legal page

> A single readable column (max 760px) for terms, privacy and cookies: a mono label, a t-hero title at a smaller size, the update date in mono, and 16px/1.6 body with 22px section headings.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/legal-page/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- For long-form reading.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` (no JavaScript).

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Cookie policy

```html
<article class="legal" aria-labelledby="lg-h">
  <p class="t-mono label"><span class="chev">&gt;</span> Legal</p>
  <h1 id="lg-h" class="t-hero">Cookie policy</h1>
  <p class="t-mono upd">Last updated 14 November 2026</p>
  <p>This site uses as little as possible on your device.</p>
  <h2>What we store</h2><p>We remember your light or dark theme choice in your browser’s local storage, so the site looks the way you left it. It stays on your device and is never sent to us.</p><h2>What we do not use</h2><p>We do not use advertising or tracking cookies, and we do not run third-party analytics that follow you across sites.</p><h2>Hosting</h2><p>Our hosting and security provider may set strictly necessary cookies to protect the site from abuse. These are needed for the site to work and do not track you.</p><h2>Your choices</h2><p>You can clear local storage and cookies at any time in your browser settings. The site will still work; it will just forget your theme.</p>
</article>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `article.legal` | element | max-width 760px; padding below the header. |
| `.upd.t-mono` | element | "Last updated <date>". |
| `h2` | element | 22px, 500, -.02em, 44px above. |

## Do

- Date every version.

## Don't

- Do not publish legal text that has not been reviewed.

## Accessibility

- One H1; sections are H2.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| typography.hero | `.t-hero` | `{"fontFamily":"'Inter Tight',ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif","fontWeight":500,"fontSize":"clamp(44px,6.4vw,112px)","lineHeight":".94","letterSpacing":"-.045em","color":"var(--strong)"}` |
| typography.body | `` | `{"fontFamily":"'Inter Tight',ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif","fontSize":"16px","lineHeight":"1.6"}` |

## Sources

- markup and copy: [tools/v5pages.py:270-311](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/tools/v5pages.py#L270-L311)

# Skip link

> The first element on every page: "Skip to content", off screen until it receives focus, then a strong box at top left.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /components/skip-link/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

## Use it

- On every page, pointing at <main id="main">.

Needs: `vimaksh.css` (no JavaScript).

## Markup

The markup below is copied from the live site. Inline SVGs are abbreviated: paste the file contents where a comment says so.

### Press Tab inside the frame

```html
<a class="skip" href="#main">Skip to content</a><main id="main" style="padding:80px var(--pad)"><p class="t-big">Press Tab: the skip link appears at the top left.</p></main>
```

## API

| Name | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `a.skip[href="#main"]` | element | Off screen until :focus. |
| `.sr` | class | Visually hidden text (e.g. "(opens in a new tab)"). |

## Accessibility

- Required: it is the first focusable element.

## Connected foundations

| Token | CSS variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color.theme.strong | `--strong` | `#0B0A14 / #F4F5FF` |
| color.theme.paper | `--paper` | `#F4F2EE / #0F1020` |

## Sources

- markup: [tools/v5pages.py:41](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/tools/v5pages.py#L41)
- style: [src/v5/v5.css:33-35](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/v5.css#L33-L35)

# Brand

> The six-arrow mark (five coral, one red), the Vimaksh wordmark, and the 3D logo sculpture. Use the files as they are, in the colours the site uses them in.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /brand/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

### The mark
Six arrows meeting at a centre: five coral, one red. The arrows form the "> <" chevrons that run through the whole system. Files: `vimaksh-mark.svg` (580×580 artboard, the original) and `vimaksh-mark-tight.svg` (cropped to the arrows, the crop the hero uses).

### The wordmark
"vimaksh" in coral, 951×172. On the site it is inlined with `fill="currentColor"`, so it takes the colour of where it sits:

| Where on the site | Colour | File |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Header, light theme | `#0B0A14` (strong) | `vimaksh-wordmark-ink.svg` |
| Header, dark theme | `#F4F5FF` (strong) | `vimaksh-wordmark-light.svg` |
| Giant wordmark on the footer heat field | `#FFFFFF` | `vimaksh-wordmark-white.svg` |
| Original file | `#FF5F53` (coral) | `vimaksh-wordmark.svg` |

### Sizes the site uses
Wordmark: 24px high in the header (20px on phones), full width in the footer base. Mark: 96–160px wide in the footer, about 56 pixel cells across in the hero. These are observed uses, not minimums.

### Clear space and minimum size
`[PLACEHOLDER: clear space and minimum size rules, to be set by Vimaksh]`. The site has no written rule. Until there is one, give the mark at least the clearance the header gives the wordmark (the page gutter, `--pad`).

### Misuse (proposed, pending approval)
These follow from how the files are built and used; Vimaksh has not yet approved them as rules.
- Do not recolour single arrows or swap which arrow is red.
- Do not stretch or squash (the wordmark keeps `aspect-ratio: 951/172`).
- Do not outline, add shadows or put the mark on a busy photograph.
- Do not redraw the letters or set "vimaksh" in a font as a logo.
- Do not use the wordmark in a colour other than the four above.

### The 3D logo
`vimaksh-logo-sculpture.glb` (glTF binary, 1.7 MB): the mark as a sculpture, used to render the service stills. Open it in any glTF viewer or three.js.

## Sources

- mark: [public/marks/vimaksh-mark.svg:1-8](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/public/marks/vimaksh-mark.svg#L1-L8)
- wordmark: [public/marks/vimaksh-wordmark.svg:1-3](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/public/marks/vimaksh-wordmark.svg#L1-L3)
- inline currentColor: [tools/v5pages.py:6-10](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/tools/v5pages.py#L6-L10)
- sizes: [src/v5/v5.css:571-574](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/v5.css#L571-L574)
- footer mark size: [src/v5/v5.css:734-742](https://github.com/yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final/blob/8df1553f4fbb42d294d48a95060665928a999482/src/v5/v5.css#L734-L742)

# Pixel motifs

> The pixel graphics of the site, drawn by its own code: one tile per kind of software, the studio desk, pixel edges and the hero's chevron glyphs. PNG, SVG, or draw them live.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /pixel-motifs/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

Pixel graphics are drawn square by square on a small grid and scaled up with `image-rendering: pixelated`. Download them, or draw them live with the site's own functions:

```html
<canvas class="px" data-px="saas" data-kind="crm" data-c="#0E8F6E" aria-hidden="true" style="width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3"></canvas>
<script type="module">
  import { saas } from './pixel/pixelsaas.js';      // kinds: extension saas ai crm erp dashboard integrations mobile
  import { desk, pixelEdge } from './pixel/pixelart.js';
  document.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-px=saas]').forEach(c => saas(c, c.dataset.kind, c.dataset.c));
</script>
```

vimaksh.js already draws every `canvas.px` (`data-px="saas"` and `data-px="desk"`) and every `canvas.edge`. The tiles and edges are redrawn when the theme changes; the desk looks the same in both themes.

| Motif | Group | Grid | PNG | SVG |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Rotates 90° when its .row--brief is expanded.

```html
<span class="tri" aria-hidden="true">▸</span>
```

# Downloads

> Logos, pixel motifs, fonts and the 3D logo, as single files or ZIP packs, each with a SHA-256 hash.

Vimaksh design system 0.1.0. HTML: /downloads/ (local docs site). Source of truth: https://work.vimaksh.in at yakosasam797/vimakshwebsite-identity-final@8df1553.

### Packs

| Pack | Size | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [vimaksh-logos-svg.zip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/brand/zip/vimaksh-logos-svg.zip): Mark and wordmark, SVG | 13 KB | `27340c9c2a6702b116228eb5cf8dfe2a380f7bc3c04b719c004da2d4dee0eb3d` |
| [vimaksh-logos-png.zip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/brand/zip/vimaksh-logos-png.zip): Mark and wordmark, PNG 1x/2x/4x | 649 KB | `f133484b899525ec7bb846b5eea6cff1fc4df7cc09234acee79a429157acc545` |
| [vimaksh-pixel-motifs.zip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/brand/zip/vimaksh-pixel-motifs.zip): Pixel motifs, PNG + SVG | 137 KB | `cbf97f4bb0b991d6d8a47ea4c9f5eb66e25b4125b7be5c46d982b7a01ac1997b` |
| [vimaksh-fonts.zip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/brand/zip/vimaksh-fonts.zip): Inter Tight + JetBrains Mono 500 with OFL licences | 70 KB | `e672bdfe6ff23e1df7a70ec4a3e079ccd1a586c9902d02ca8a35f497870eee6a` |
| [vimaksh-brand-all.zip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/brand/zip/vimaksh-brand-all.zip): Everything above plus the 3D logo | 2514 KB | `5ba9099508df0785b64401708edcb9722b955834acf231059093095c009d95cd` |

All hashes: [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/brand/SHA256SUMS.txt), [manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/brand/manifest.json). The ZIPs are reproducible: the same source gives the same hash.

### Fonts and licences
Inter Tight (variable, 100–900) and JetBrains Mono 500, both licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1: free to use, embed and redistribute, not to sell on their own; keep the licence with the files. Licence texts: [InterTight-OFL.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/fonts/InterTight-OFL.txt), [JetBrainsMono-OFL.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/fonts/JetBrainsMono-OFL.txt). The Vimaksh name, mark and wordmark are not covered by these licences. The same font files are in `fonts/` (next to vimaksh.css, which loads them from there) and in `brand/fonts/` (the brand pack).

### Code
- [vimaksh.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/vimaksh.css): tokens + type + every component, one file.
- [tokens.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/tokens.css), [tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/tokens.json) (W3C design tokens), [tailwind-preset.cjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/tailwind-preset.cjs), [tailwind.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/tailwind.css).
- [vimaksh.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/vimaksh.js), [vimaksh-phone.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/vimaksh-phone.js), [pixel-hero.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/pixel-hero.js), [pixel/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system/main/dist/pixel/pixelsaas.js).
- As a package: `npm i github:yakosasam797/vimaksh-design-system`, then import `@vimaksh/design-system/vimaksh.css`.
